Graduate Application Process
Get ready to apply!
The Graduate Admissions team and your graduate academic program faculty look forward
to working with you throughout the admission process.
Hereâs what you need to do.
1. Review Admission RequirementsÂ
Before applying, review your admission requirements. Requirements vary by academic
college and individual program.
Admission requirements
2. Complete the ApplicationÂ
To begin your application, visit the Applying for Graduate Admission page and choose the option that applies to you.
Complete the application fully. You can continue to make changes to your application
until it has been submitted. Once you submit your application, you can no longer make
changes and you will be prompted to pay the application fee. After your application
has been submitted and paid, you can visit your Application Status Page to view the
status of your application and instructions for submitting any required documents.
Your application is not considered complete until the fee has been paid and all admission
requirements have been met.
Please Note:
Select programs require a National Centralized Application (CAS) and are listed on
the application page. If your program is listed, complete the CAS application using
the link listed with your program. Do not complete The University of Toledo application.
3. Submit Transcripts
Current UToledo students do not need to order their UToledo transcripts (excluding
law, medical school, or CAS applications). The University of Toledo must be listed
in the academic history section of your application, and then the transcripts will
be retrieved on your behalf by the Graduate Admissions team.
Transcripts are required from all previous higher education institutions. Contact
all previous institutions and request that your official transcripts are sent to The
University of Toledo Office of Graduate Admission. Transcripts are only considered
official if they are sent directly from the issuing institution to The University
of Toledo. Electronic delivery is preferred, but physical documents can be mailed
in an original sealed envelope with the school registrarâs stamp intact. Physical
documents can be mailed to:
The University of Toledo
College of Graduate Studies
2801 W. Bancroft, MS 933
Toledo, OH 43606
Transcripts should indicate the degree earned, date of conferral, and a key to the
grading system used. All transcripts should be submitted in their original language.
A foreign credential evaluation is required for all applicants who have completed coursework or degrees at non-US
institutions.
4. Submit Required Supporting Materials
Visit your Application Status Page to view outstanding items required to complete
your application. Some items may be uploaded directly via the Status Page, while others
must be sent externally. Your application cannot be forwarded to the academic department
for a final decision until all required supporting documentation has been received.
Applicants whose native language is not English and who received their undergraduate
degrees from non-English speaking institutions must demonstrate a minimum level of
English proficiency to be considered for admission into a UToledo graduate program.
Please review Proof of English Language Proficiency for Graduate Students for more information.Â
5. Monitor Your Application Status
Once your application is complete, it will be reviewed by Office of Graduate Admission
staff and then sent to the academic department for a decision. To check the status
of your application, log in using the corresponding link below:
Degree-seeking and non-degree seeking applications
Combined Bachelorâs to Masterâs applications
When an admission decision is made, you will receive an email notification to view
the decision letter on your application status page.
Decisions for most programs are made on a rolling basis. Some programs have a limited
number of seats available and may make admission decisions on a specific date. Check
with your program for details.
6. Confirm Your Enrollment
To confirm your enrollment, you will need to complete the âIntent to Enrollâ form
found on your application status page.Â
